title: The 2026 Oklahoma Local AI Shortlist Study & AEO Research Archive (Reports 003-004)
description: Replication datasets, saved API responses, CSV tables, and zero-network Python verification scripts for Report 003 (Beyond Citation Count) and Report 004 (The 2026 Oklahoma Local AI Shortlist Study: 1,080 saved Gemini API responses with Google Search grounding across 15 Oklahoma cities and 12 local service categories). Published by 580 Digital Infrastructure in Lawton, Oklahoma.
